summary: The core toy numerics are fine: the script computes the single-qubit amplitude-damping Choi-state log-negativity correctly (matching LN = log2(1+η)), and comparing that toy quantity against the single-edge Pirandola/PLOB formula -log2(1-η) is acceptable as a descriptive baseline. The regression is in the prose layered on top: the new γ script text silently upgrades the toy Choi-state diagnostic into a claimed γ bound/"rigorous derivation," and MQ §11.0.3 turns the β/γ toy ratio into a directional formalization claim that is not consistent with the explicitly agnostic β.G3 v0.4 stance.

issues.description: The sentence "若 β 正确 formal 成立，会给约 5× tighter than γ" is not just a toy descriptive comparison. It upgrades the η=0.1 toy ratio (0.19 vs 0.90) into a directional statement about the formal β path. That conflicts with the immediately preceding agnostic β.G3 stance in the same snapshot (§11.0.2, lines 241-246), where β-vs-Pirandola is still explicitly unknown and not a basis for fast-tracking β.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite this as a strictly local toy observation, e.g. "At η=0.1, the two toy surrogates differ by about 4.7× (0.19 vs 0.90 relative to Pirandola), but this does not predict the formal β-vs-γ ordering." Do not tie the toy ratio to "if β formal成立".

issues.description: The docstring says the γ path toy "only provides rigorous derivation via data-processing monotonicity," but the project's own γ v0.4/v0.5 derivation document still marks the DPI transfer step as an open [CONJ] target lemma with multiple major gaps. Calling it a rigorous derivation is a silent rigor upgrade.
issues.suggestion: Downgrade the prose to match the current project status, e.g. say this script is a toy numerical companion for the single-edge baseline and does not establish the γ derivation.

issues.description: The interpretation block moves from a computed Choi-state quantity to "So γ bound ≤ LN(E_1)" and "γ's single-channel LN". The code only computes log-negativity of the amplitude-damping Choi state. Without an explicit justified reduction from the channel bound target E_R^∞(E_1) to the Choi-state LN for this non-bosonic toy channel, that wording overstates what the numeric actually proves.
issues.suggestion: Relabel the quantity consistently as "Choi-state LN toy diagnostic" and frame the ratio as informational only. Avoid stating it as the γ bound unless a separate lemma establishing that channel-to-state reduction is added.

round_recommendation: Round 1: remove the silent upgrades. Keep the γ numerical as a toy Choi-state diagnostic, and rewrite MQ §11.0.3 so the β/γ comparison is purely descriptive toy arithmetic, not a prediction about the formal β path.
